description: A $2,500 award for a sophomore or junior enrolled full-time in a STEM major at a four-year accredited U.S. college.
eligibility_text: Must be an undergraduate student enrolled full-time at a four-year accredited U.S. college; online degree programs are eligible. Must be a sophomore or junior at the time of application. Must have a minimum overall GPA of 3.0 in their current academic program. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Students attending a community college, freshmen and seniors are not eligible.
